cards.back:
A person who helps you get well.
Bahasa Indonesia: dokter
Example: The doctor asks me many questions.
cards.say: doctor. The doctor asks me many questions.

cards.back:
A person who is ill and sees a doctor.
Bahasa Indonesia: pasien
Example: The patient waits in a chair.
cards.say: patient. The patient waits in a chair.

cards.back:
A small place where a doctor sees people.
Bahasa Indonesia: klinik
Example: We visit the clinic near our house.
cards.say: clinic. We visit the clinic near our house.

cards.back:
A person who helps the doctor and looks after patients.
Bahasa Indonesia: perawat
Example: The nurse takes my temperature.
cards.say: nurse. The nurse takes my temperature.

cards.back:
A time you agree to see someone.
Bahasa Indonesia: janji temu
Example: I have an appointment at ten.
cards.say: appointment. I have an appointment at ten.

cards.back:
A room where you sit before you see the doctor.
Bahasa Indonesia: ruang tunggu
Example: We sit in the waiting room.
cards.say: waiting room. We sit in the waiting room.

cards.back:
How hot your body is.
Bahasa Indonesia: suhu tubuh
Example: The nurse checks my temperature.
cards.say: temperature. The nurse checks my temperature.

cards.back:
A tool that shows how hot something is.
Bahasa Indonesia: termometer
Example: The thermometer is under my arm.
cards.say: thermometer. The thermometer is under my arm.

cards.back:
A small needle that puts medicine into your body.
Bahasa Indonesia: suntikan
Example: The injection hurts for a second.
cards.say: injection. The injection hurts for a second.

cards.back:
Something you take to get well.
Bahasa Indonesia: obat
Example: The doctor gives me some medicine.
cards.say: medicine. The doctor gives me some medicine.

cards.back:
A small hard piece of medicine that you swallow.
Bahasa Indonesia: tablet
Example: Take one tablet after lunch.
cards.say: tablet. Take one tablet after lunch.

cards.back:
A thick sweet liquid medicine.
Bahasa Indonesia: sirup obat
Example: The cough syrup tastes sweet.
cards.say: syrup. The cough syrup tastes sweet.

cards.back:
A soft thick medicine that you put on your skin.
Bahasa Indonesia: krim atau salep
Example: The nurse puts cream on my arm.
cards.say: cream. The nurse puts cream on my arm.

cards.back:
A small sticky cover for a cut.
Bahasa Indonesia: plester
Example: I have a plaster on my finger.
cards.say: plaster. I have a plaster on my finger.

cards.back:
A feeling that something hurts.
Bahasa Indonesia: rasa sakit
Example: I feel a pain in my leg.
cards.say: pain. I feel a pain in my leg.

cards.back:
To feel pain.
Bahasa Indonesia: sakit atau terluka
Example: My knee hurts a lot.
cards.say: hurt. My knee hurts a lot.

cards.back:
A pain that lasts for a long time.
Bahasa Indonesia: nyeri
Example: I have an ache in my back.
cards.say: ache. I have an ache in my back.

cards.back:
Red marks on the skin.
Bahasa Indonesia: ruam
Example: I have a red rash on my arm.
cards.say: rash. I have a red rash on my arm.

cards.back:
A body that is too hot when you are ill.
Bahasa Indonesia: demam
Example: The baby has a high fever.
cards.say: fever. The baby has a high fever.

cards.back:
To push air out of your throat with a noise.
Bahasa Indonesia: batuk
Example: The dust makes me cough.
cards.say: cough. The dust makes me cough.

cards.back:
To look at something carefully.
Bahasa Indonesia: memeriksa
Example: The doctor will check my ears.
cards.say: check. The doctor will check my ears.

cards.back:
More well than before.
Bahasa Indonesia: lebih baik
Example: I feel better now.
cards.say: better. I feel better now.

cards.back:
To relax and not work.
Bahasa Indonesia: beristirahat
Example: Rest at home for two days.
cards.say: rest. Rest at home for two days.
